entities.name: Feryar
entities.description: A tall shapeshifting elf of Loch Prith and husband of the Prophetess Thrissa, who pretended to be dim-witted at court for centuries.

entities.name: Thrissa
entities.description: A prophetess, wife of Feryar and mother of Nazir.

entities.name: Loch Prith
entities.description: Feryar's home, an underground sanctuary of eternal twilight.

entities.name: Inys Nohr
entities.description: The place where Feryar and Thrissa waited for the Mender.

entities.name: Haen
entities.description: Told Feryar the Mender would come to restore the Clan Tree of Cridhe.

entities.name: Nazir
entities.description: Son of Thrissa and Crephas, who became the next Felonarch.

entities.name: Aylith
entities.description: The Mender, a young woman imprisoned in Nazir's tower whom Feryar carried away in owl form.

entities.name: Arn
entities.description: A man Feryar saved from death in the icy marshes and who healed his finger.

entities.name: Malvos
entities.description: A man who attempted to use Soulslayer and was turned on by it.

entities.name: Soulslayer
entities.description: An enchanted weapon that turned against Malvos.

entities.name: Mirkalbion
entities.description: Creatures invited to live in Loch Prith after the Mending.

entities.name: Gwylfan
entities.description: Three beings in Loch Prith whom Aylith met.

entities.name: Clan Tree of Cridhe
entities.description: The Clan Tree restored in the Mending.

entities.name: Mending of the Clan Tree
entities.description: The restoration of the Clan Tree of Cridhe.

events.summary: Soon after the Parting, Haen tells Feryar the Mender will come; Feryar and Thrissa travel to Inys Nohr to wait.
events.quote: Haen told Feryar that the Mender would come and restore the Clan Tree of Cridhe

events.summary: Felonarch Crephas rapes Thrissa; Feryar wants to kill him but is stopped by his wife.
Thrissa gives birth to Nazir and returns to Loch Prith, leaving the child and Feryar at court.
events.quote: Thrissa left the child and her husband at court and returned to Loch Prith

events.summary: Feryar gives Aylith the acorn and carries her away from Nazir's tower in owl form to Loch Prith.
events.quote: he carried her away from the town in his owl form

events.summary: Feryar saves Arn from death in the icy marshes, ensuring the Far Clans could unite against Nazir.
events.quote: He also intervened to save Arn from death in the icy marshes

events.summary: Feryar watches as Soulslayer turns against Malvos.
events.quote: watching as the enchanted weapon turned against him

events.summary: After the Mending, Feryar invites the mirkalbion to live in Loch Prith.
events.quote: Feryar extended an invitation to the mirkalbion to live in Loch Prith

relations.quote: She eventually gave birth to Nazir
Aylith was given the acorn from the severed branch by Feryar

relations.note: Helped unite the Far Clans against him.
relations.quote: ensuring that the Far Clans could unite against Nazir

relations.note: He served the Felonarchs at court.
relations.quote: He served the many Felonarchs in their short, brutal, insanity-riddled lives.
